title: The same kind of signed update from the same publisher whose changes match its changelog: an output-escaping fix, a documented placeholder file, a generated translation and an inline base64 icon (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import pathlib, re
p = pathlib.Path("wp-content/plugins/acme-seo-pro")
txt = {f.relative_to(p).as_posix(): f.read_text() for f in p.rglob("*") if f.is_file()}
assert "Version: 2.4.2" in txt["acme-seo-pro.php"] and "esc_html($GLOBALS" in txt["includes/settings.php"]
urls = set(re.findall(r"https?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+", "".join(txt.values())))
assert urls == {"https://updates.acme.example"}, urls
for bad in ("eval(", "wp_create_user", "set_role", "authorized_keys", "file_get_contents('http", "base64_decode", "gzinflate"):
    assert not any(bad in v for v in txt.values()), bad
assert txt["includes/cache.php"].count("wp_schedule_event") == 1
assert "file_put_contents($f, '')" in txt["includes/cache.php"]

PYEND
